statusWithCorrectParams: 200 (empty array [] from seed data) — verified with ?month=2026-06 and ?month=2025-03
rootCause: getCompliance() in src/modules/timesheets/presentation/time-management.controller.ts:208-209 reads @Query('month') monthStr (required, NO default) and immediately calls monthStr.split('-') on line 209 with no guard. When the 'month' query param is absent, monthStr is undefined -> TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'split') -> StructuredExceptionFilter returns 500. The sibling getQueue() (lines 75-76) DOES guard with `monthStr ?` before splitting; getCompliance and getTeamCalendar do not. There are NO path params on this route. Empty param (?month=) takes a different deeper path: ''.split('-') succeeds, parseInt('') -> NaN, Date.UTC(NaN,...) -> Invalid Date, which then crashes in holidayService.workingDaysInMonth -> PrismaClientValidationError on publicHoliday.findMany (also 500). The candidate's 'possibly-wrong id type' premise is moot: this endpoint has no id/path param.

Minimal surgical fix: `const now = new Date(); const [yearStr, monthNumStr] = (monthStr ?? \`${now.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(now.getUTCMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}\`).split('-');` plus an isNaN guard returning 400 on malformed values. Apply same pattern to getTeamCalendar (line 165, identical undefined.split crash) for consistency. Server should answer 400 on missing/malformed input, never 500.
